resetTasks.title: Reset tasks?
resetTasks.bodyWithProgress: {{done}} completed task(s) out of {{total}} will be lost. The proposal and design will be kept.
resetTasks.bodyNoProgress: Tasks for "{{name}}" will be cleared. The proposal and design will be kept.
resetTasks.bodyWithBranch: The feature/{{name}} branch, its worktree and all committed work will be deleted, along with the tasks ({{done}}/{{total}} completed). The proposal and design will be kept. This cannot be undone.

deleteChange.title: Delete this change?
deleteChange.body: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

archiveChange.title: Archive this change?
archiveChange.body: "{{name}}" will be synced with the active specs and then archived. This cannot be undone.

agentSettings.title: Agent Configuration
agentSettings.description: These environment variables will be hot-injected when launching the CLI agent process.
agentSettings.googleCloudProjectDesc: Google Cloud Project ID required for authentication.
agentSettings.systemActive: Will be inherited from system environment
agentSettings.nativeQuestionModeDesc: Re-enables the native AskUserQuestion tool for Claude. Has no effect on other agents.

agentPool.title: Launch Agent Pool
agentPool.body: You are about to launch automatic processing of the cards in the Todo column. Tasks will be distributed and processed in parallel according to their dependencies.

fullAutonomy.label: Full Autonomy
fullAutonomy.description: Agents modify the main codebase and move cards directly to DONE.

hitlReview.label: Review-based Development (HITL)
hitlReview.description: Agents work on isolated branches. Completed cards wait for your validation in the TO REVIEW column before being merged into Git.

statusPanel.title: Agent Pool Running
statusPanel.noWorkers: No worker is currently assigned to a change.

reviewCorrection.title: Request a correction
reviewCorrection.body: Describe what is wrong with "{{name}}": the feedback is added as a task and the agent picks the change up again.

reviewApprove.title: Approve & merge?
reviewApprove.body: "{{name}}" will be merged into "{{target}}", then its branch and worktree are deleted.
reviewApprove.bodyNoTarget: "{{name}}" will be merged into the current branch, then its branch and worktree are deleted.
reviewApprove.cleanupWarning: "{{name}}" is merged, but some cleanup is left to do by hand: {{items}}.

reviewErrors.not_in_review: This change is no longer in review.
reviewErrors.worker_active: A worker is active on this change.
reviewErrors.merge_in_progress: A merge is already in progress in the repository: finish or abort it, then retry.
reviewErrors.base_branch_mismatch: The repository is no longer on the change's base branch: switch back to it, then retry.
reviewErrors.integration_conflict: Integrating the target branch conflicts with the change: nothing was merged, the change stays in review.
reviewErrors.target_moving: The target branch keeps advancing: retry in a few moments.
reviewErrors.validation_failed: Validation failed after integrating the target branch: nothing was merged, the change stays in review.
reviewErrors.tasks_pending: Some tasks are still to be validated: check them all before approving. Nothing was merged.
